points.description: Setup: labels the data as two classes (+1/-1, or positive/negative) and initialises the weights (randomly or to zero; a bias may be included via an augmented input).

Update rule applied to misclassified points: if a sample x(n) is misclassified (e.g. y*<w,x> <= 0, or for the simplified form with all inputs sign-adjusted <w,x> <= 0), update w <- w + eta*y(n)*x(n) (simplified: Δw = eta*x(n)). Correctly classified points leave w unchanged. The sign/direction of the update must be correct.

levels.says: Updates the weights on errors but the rule is vague or the formula is incomplete (e.g. no learning rate or label/sign given).

points.description: Loop structure: repeats passes (epochs) over all the training points until a stopping criterion is met (no misclassifications / weights no longer change or change little).

levels.says: Mentions repetition but gives no clear stopping criterion, or gives only a fixed number of epochs.

rubric.notes: Full marks need setup (labels, initial weights), a correct update rule applied only to misclassified points, and repeated epochs until no change/no errors. Part marks for vague update rule or missing stopping criterion. A mention of convergence for linearly separable data is optional and not required for marks.
